en.summary: The probability of Houthis successfully targeting shipping by September 2026 dropped significantly to 16%, driven by recent reports of enhanced coalition naval operations and successful interdictions. This suggests a perceived degradation of Houthi capabilities.

Successful interdiction of Houthi drone/missile shipments
Reports of precision strikes on Houthi launch sites
